ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR34] Requires GSA/SLED/Public Sector Pricing while in Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification, for US/Canada billing deals. Simplified per IRM feedback.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Renewal') ),
OR( QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'United States', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Canada' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ),
ISPICKVAL(US_Federal_GSA_Pricing__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: GSA/SLED/Public Sector Pricing is required to advance to the next stage. Please select a value.
